finding: Important correction to runs 241-244: historical legal-entity labels must not be demoted to host-only merely because individual sites are operated by another CPO. A 2025 Adiconsum observatory explicitly derived from the official PUN CPO list names several of these entities as CPOs, including Leitner Energy GmbH (78/78 active/total), Spesa Intelligente Spa (26/26), Eurospin Tirrenica S.p.A. (22/22), Eurospin Lazio Spa (14/14), Enercom S.r.l. (14/14), EUM Genossenschaft (12/12), T.D.M. S.r.l. (12/12), Clean Energy srl (11/11), Y&F Srl (21/24), E.ON Drive Infrastructure Italy S.r.l. (18/18), and ENERBROKER/R-ev (84/84). Therefore these names are valid historical PUN CPO identities even when some retail locations are operated by third parties. Current 2026 partyId reconciliation remains required before counting them in the current 92-party inventory.
